comparison: Use the median of frozen D4.3-E unmodified stock P1 full wall times on the same WSL machine. Also record a contemporary stock cross-check.
warning: Flag a boundary at or above half the reference P1 wall time (within a factor of two), a frozen resource limit, or repeated barrier rebuilds without ordinary search. Report both raw times and ratios. Stop expansion of full searches at the first warning.
boundary_work: One sequential P0/P1 session per case, no ordinary branch, no inferred SAT. Time assumptions processing, joint fixpoint and rollback, excluding input installation and assumption vector construction.
selectors: One per distinct canonical nontrivial clause in its scope plus query and epoch. Order: epoch controls by first registration, query controls by first registration, clause selectors by first registration, native assumptions in input order.
search: Only after small correctness controls and boundary cost gate. No parameter search.
